title: Boston Gas Company files its 365 Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement, which has been executed by Boston Gas Company and Caritas Norwood Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department of Telecommunications & Energy APPROVES Boston Gas Company's proposed Agreement with Caritas Norwood Hospital. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
